full_text_zh:
[P1] 谁是主角？
[英]尼科拉·奥布莱恩 著
张浩 译

河北出版传媒集团 河北少年儿童出版社

[P2] 在热闹而欢乐的一天将要结束的时候，没有什么事能比
在睡觉之前读一个故事更好了。
这是一天当中最重要的时刻，你会选择听哪个故事呢？
嘿，三只小猪，你们在听我说话吗？

[P3] 我刚才问，睡前你最想听哪个故事呢？
嗯，请稍等，我们的主角们还没准备好。
可是，这场球
我还没踢完呢！
睡前最后一个故事？
嘿，听起来挺有意思！
不好意思，三只小猪，故事现在就要开始。
我还有时间吃
块蛋糕吗？
瞌睡虫已经飞到了小朋友的眼皮上，你们要快速进入角色！否则
我们就换一个别的故事！
来吧，好戏就要上演了……

[P4] 很久很久以前，三只小猪和他们的妈妈生活在一起。当他们长大后，猪妈妈鼓励他们去外面的世界闯荡。
在他们离开家前，猪妈妈在每只小猪的鼻子上都亲了一下，
说：“今后，你们一定要努力干活儿，而且要记住，千万要
小心大灰狼！”
家
大千世界

[P5] 不久，三只小猪来到了一片草地上。草地上开着
芬芳的花儿，还有一条小河汩汩地从桥下流过。大猪说：
“这片草地太美了！我要在这儿用稻草盖一间房子！”

但是，在大猪开始盖他的房子之前，一个粉红色
的身影突然出现了。

不过，我们
都知道后来会
发生什么。

我想知道什么
时候吃午饭。

嗯？你们是谁？

[P6] 原来是 灰姑娘。

如果这是睡前的最后一个故事，我们应该讲一个关于 公主 的故事。我的故事非常浪漫，既有恶毒的继母，也有英俊的王子。而且大家都知道，我的故事都已经被拍成了电影，人们还制作了好多漂亮的玩偶。我想，没人会愿意看你们这些“肉排”的电影。

嘿！你打断了我们的故事！

还有，你说谁是“肉排”？

我还没开始盖我的砖头房子呢！

[P7] 很久很久以前，有一个漂亮的小姑娘与她 恶毒 的继母和两个 丑陋 的姐姐生活在一起。小姑娘很可爱，但是她的继母和姐姐都对她很刻薄。

继母和两个姐姐让她睡在壁炉旁边，这让她身上总是沾着一层灰。所以，人们都叫她“灰姑娘”。

一天，王宫里送来了请柬。王子要举办一场盛大的舞会，每个人都受到了邀请。其实，并不是每个人都收到了请柬，因为不包括灰姑娘——她 恶毒 的继母 不让她去。

谁在乎?! 我只知道这个故事里有一场盛大的舞会和美味的食物！

等等，这真的是一个浪漫的故事吗？

我要提醒你们，在灰姑娘的故事里可没有咱小猪什么事！

别急，小猪们，你们三个可以扮演故事里 恶毒 的继母和两个 丑陋 的姐姐。就这么决定了！小猪们，装扮起来吧！

[P8] 当三只小猪，啊，不好意思，应该是当 恶毒 的继
母和 丑陋 的姐姐们离开家以后，灰姑娘就哭了起来，
因为她也非常想参加这场舞会。
突然，“啪”的一声，一个仙女出现了！
我是说……一个仙女出现了！
呃，有点儿尴尬。不过不要着急，仙女肯定会出现的，
让我们再试一下。
但谁来扮演这个
仙女呢？
参加舞会的
时间到了！
我只期待着我
的蛋糕。
突然，“啪”的一声，一个……

[P9] 小红帽和大灰狼了？出现了！真令人吃惊！

我错过什么了吗？

听好了，仙女不会出现了，别再
想什么公主的故事了。睡前最后一个
故事应该充满惊险和刺激，让人感到
兴奋。我的故事比那个灰姑娘的故事
有意思多了。

既然现在你们都出现了，那就让我们继续讲故事吧！

什么嘛，我认为
灰姑娘的故事也非常
令人兴奋哪！我说的
没错吧！

哦，是你！

这么说，故事
又要重新开始了？

但是，在刚才
那个故事里，我们
马上要讲到有蛋糕
的部分了。

大家都别急！我们重新来。

灰姑娘，你来演小红帽的妈妈。小猪，你来演小红帽的外婆。而你，大灰狼，
你等一会儿再出场。

[P10] 很久很久以前，有一个小女孩儿，她的斗篷上有一个漂亮的红色兜帽，因此大家都叫她“小红帽”。有一天，她的妈妈对她说：“请你把这篮食物送给你的外婆好吗？
不过，你独自在森林里走的时候千万不要离开大路，还要小心
大灰狼！
演妈妈一点儿
也不好玩儿。
我什么戏
份儿都没有。
至少我可以
演外婆！
外婆不是
会被吃掉吗？
快轮到我出场了！
你知道的，我才是这个
故事的主角！

[P11] 小红帽一蹦一跳地往前走，猜猜她遇到了谁？大灰狼！
“早上好，小红帽。”大灰狼说，“这么早你一个人要去哪儿呀？”

“我要去看我那可怜的外婆，她生病了，我要给她送去一些妈妈做的桂花酒和蛋糕。”小红帽回答。

哼，我就只有
那么一句台词。

我现在饿
得很呀！

哼哼，至少你还有台词可说。

都别抱怨了，
真无聊，我想
翻到下一页。

[P12] 大家都安静点儿，别把故事搞乱了！翻书的时候轻一些，你们
不知道书是纸做的吗？！

真荒唐！如果我不能当故事的主角，那谁也别想当！
我要把这本书扯烂！

说好的蛋糕在哪儿呢？

哼！灰姑娘，你这一套
我也会，凭什么总让你当故事的主角！

快停下！这样下去结果会很糟的！

哈哈，真好玩儿，我喜欢演坏人！

我受够这无聊的故事了，让我们
离开这儿吧！

不，不要这样做！你们会……

[P13] 把
书
撕坏！

[P14] 哦，不！书被撕成了碎片！
现在该睡觉了，但我们没有故事可讲了。快想一想，
我们还能做点儿什么呢？
我倒是有一个主意！但需要我们大家齐心协力。你们想要一个什么样的故事？
一个有趣的故事！
一个浪漫的故事！
一个惊险的故事！
一个令人兴奋的故事！
一个有蛋糕吃的故事！来吧，让我们开始吧！

[P15] 很久很久以前，三只勤劳、聪明的小猪生活在一起。他们住在一座用砖头砌成的漂亮房子里，房子建在一个非常美丽的地方。一天下午，他们邀请好朋友小红帽和灰姑娘一起来家里喝茶、品尝蛋糕。

就在这时，小红帽敲了敲三只小猪家的门。
进门后，小红帽说：“灰姑娘刚才告诉我，她觉得身体不舒服，不能来喝茶了。”

我们终于吃到蛋糕了！
再来点儿茶吗？
好的，谢谢。

“那我们去看看她吧！”小小猪遗憾地说。他不仅长得帅气，而且还有一副热心肠。就这样，大家把茶和蛋糕都装好，出发去看灰姑娘了。

[P16] 通往灰姑娘家的路弯弯曲曲，还要穿过一片又大又阴暗的森林。猜猜他们会在那里碰见谁？

三只小猪和小红帽害怕碰见大灰狼，所以他们决定悄无声息地、一口气跑到灰姑娘家。但是，大灰狼还是发现了他们的踪迹，而且猜到了他们要去哪里。

“我要抢先溜到灰姑娘家里去。”大灰狼想，“等他们一到，我就立刻把他们都吃掉！”，

[P17] 三只小猪和小红帽来到灰姑娘家，发现 有个人 躺在
床上——这个人 还戴着灰姑娘最喜欢的粉色头巾。
小红帽说：“你的 眼睛 可真大呀。”
这个人 答道：“这样才能看清你可爱的样子呀。”
小红帽又说：“你的 耳朵 可真大呀。”
这个人 回答说：“这样才能听清你清脆的声音呀。”
三只小猪仔仔细细地打量了 这个人。
小小猪说：“你的 牙齿 可真大呀。”
“这样才能更好地……”

[P18] “吃掉你们！”
大灰狼一边吼着，一边
从床上跳起来扑向他们。

不过，小小猪很镇定，
因为他很清楚应该怎么应对……

[P19] 他一个箭步冲向前，用尽全身力气把一大块蛋糕塞到了
大灰狼的血盆大口里。
“真是太好吃啦！”大灰狼喊道，“比小猪和小女孩
儿还要好吃！”，

这时，大猪把灰姑娘从衣橱里救了出来。
灰姑娘立马爱上了这个救她的英雄。

这就是故事中最浪漫的部分吗？但我是只
小猪呀！

没关系，
没有谁是完美的。

不过他们并没有亲亲，因为这是一个
给孩子们读的睡前故事。

[P20] 从此，这些童话故事里的主人公都过上了幸福的生活。
大家都表现得非常棒，这是我读过的最适合在睡前讲的故事啦！

在这个故事里，
我们想要的东西都有了！

没错！这个故事有趣、惊险、令人兴奋，
又浪漫！

而且我们还吃到了
蛋糕！

不过我还是很饿，
因为我谁也没吃着。

可是，在我的故事里，
你永远不会真的吃掉谁。

等一下，这个
小孩儿怎么还没睡着！

[P21] 你还醒着？！哦，不！可是这个故事已经讲完了！看来我们还需要一个新故事！
这回，我们可以再讲个结局圆满的故事吗？
哈，一个新故事！我喜欢睡前故事！
让我们讲一个能吃到香蕉的故事吧！
不，讲一个可以让我吃掉小动物的故事吧！
我想听一个有关公主的故事。当然，这只是说说而已。
我希望故事的开篇可以这么讲：“很久很久以前……”
你会选哪一种故事呢？
full_text_en:
[P1] Who is the main character?
[UK] Nicola O'Brien, Author
Zhang Hao, Translator

Hebei Publishing Media Group, Hebei Children's Publishing House

[P2] When a lively and joyful day is about to end, there's nothing better than reading a story before bedtime.
This is the most important moment of the day. Which story will you choose to listen to?
Hey, three little pigs, are you listening to me?

[P3] I just asked, which story would you most like to hear before bed?
Well, please wait a moment, our protagonists aren't ready yet.
But, this game
I haven't finished playing yet!
One last story before bed?
Hey, that sounds pretty interesting!
Sorry, three little pigs, the story is starting now.
Do I still have time to eat
a piece of cake?
The sleepy bug has already flown to the child's eyelids, you need to quickly get into character! Otherwise
we'll switch to a different story!
Come on, the show is about to begin...

[P4] Long, long ago, the three little pigs lived with their mother. When they grew up, Pig Mama encouraged them to go out into the world.
Before they left home, Pig Mama kissed each piglet on the nose,
saying: "From now on, you must work hard, and remember to be very careful of the Big Bad Wolf!"
Home
The Big Wide World

[P5] Soon, the three little pigs arrived at a meadow. The meadow was blooming with fragrant flowers, and a small river flowed gently beneath the bridge. The big pig said:
"This meadow is so beautiful! I want to build a house here with straw!"

But before the big pig could start building his house, a pink figure suddenly appeared.

However, we
all know what will
happen later.

I want to know when
lunch will be.

Huh? Who are you?

[P6] It's Cinderella.

If this is the last story before bedtime, we should tell a story about a princess. My story is very romantic, with a wicked stepmother and a handsome prince. And everyone knows, my story has already been made into movies, and people have made many beautiful dolls. I think no one would want to watch your 'steaks' movies.

Hey! You interrupted our story!

Also, who are you calling 'steaks'?

I haven't even started building my brick house yet!

[P7] Long, long ago, there was a beautiful little girl who lived with her wicked stepmother and two ugly sisters. The girl was lovely, but her stepmother and sisters were very cruel to her.

The stepmother and sisters made her sleep by the fireplace, so she was always covered in soot. That's why everyone called her "Cinderella".

One day, an invitation arrived from the palace. The prince was hosting a grand ball, and everyone was invited. Actually, not everyone received an invitation, because Cinderella was not included—her wicked stepmother wouldn't let her go.

Who cares?! I only know this story has a grand ball and delicious food!

Wait, is this really a romantic story?

I must remind you, in Cinderella's story, there's no place for our little pigs!

Don't worry, little pigs, you three can play the roles of the wicked stepmother and the two ugly sisters in the story. That's decided! Little pigs, get dressed up!

[P8] When the three little pigs, ah, sorry, should be the wicked stepmother and ugly sisters left home, Cinderella started crying, because she also wanted to attend the ball.
Suddenly, with a 'pop', a fairy appeared!
I mean... a fairy appeared!
Well, a bit awkward. But don't worry, the fairy will definitely appear, let's try again.
But who will play this fairy?
The time for the ball has come!
I'm just looking forward to my cake.
Suddenly, with a 'pop', a...

[P9] Little Red Riding Hood and the Big Bad Wolf? Here they are! What a surprise!

What did I miss?

Listen up, the fairy won't be appearing. No more thinking about princess stories. The last bedtime story should be full of adventure and excitement, making people feel thrilled. My story is much more interesting than that Cinderella story.

Now that you're all here, let's continue the story!

What nonsense! I think the Cinderella story is also very exciting! I'm right, aren't I?

Oh, it's you!

So, does that mean the story is starting over?

But, in that previous story, we were about to get to the part with the cake.

Everyone, calm down! Let's start over.

Cinderella, you'll play Little Red Riding Hood's mother. Pig, you'll play Little Red Riding Hood's grandmother. And you, Big Bad Wolf, wait a moment before making your entrance.

[P10] Long, long ago, there was a little girl whose cloak had a beautiful red hood, so everyone called her "Little Red Riding Hood." One day, her mother said to her: "Please take this basket of food to your grandmother, okay?\nBut when you walk alone in the forest, never leave the main path, and be careful of\nthe Big Bad Wolf!\nPlaying mom isn't any fun at all.\nI don't even have any lines.\nAt least I can play grandma!\nWon't grandma be eaten?\nIt's almost my turn to appear!\nYou know, I'm the main character of this story!

[P11] Little Red Riding Hood skips along. Guess who she meets? The Big Bad Wolf!
"Good morning, Little Red Riding Hood," says the Big Bad Wolf. "Where are you going all by yourself so early?"

"I'm going to visit my poor grandmother. She's sick, and I'm bringing her some osmanthus wine and cake that my mother made," Little Red Riding Hood replies.

Hmm, I only have
that one line.

I'm starving
right now!

Hmph, at least you still have lines to say.

Stop complaining,
this is boring, I want
to turn to the next page.

[P12] Everyone, be quiet! Don't mess up the story! Turn the pages gently—don't you know books are made of paper?!

This is ridiculous! If I can't be the main character, then nobody should be! I'll tear this book to pieces!

Where's the cake we promised?

Hmph! Cinderella, I can do that too—why do you always get to be the main character?

Stop it! This will end badly!

Haha, this is so much fun! I love playing the villain!

I've had enough of this boring story. Let's leave this place!

No, don't do that! You'll…

[P13] Tear
the book
apart!

[P14] Oh no! The book has been torn into pieces!
It's time for bed, but we have no story to tell. Think fast, what else can we do?
I actually have an idea! But it will take all of us working together. What kind of story do you want?
An interesting story!
A romantic story!
An exciting story!
An adventurous story!
A story with cake to eat! Come on, let's begin!

[P15] Long, long ago, three hardworking and clever little pigs lived together. They lived in a beautiful house made of bricks, built in a very beautiful place. One afternoon, they invited their good friends Little Red Riding Hood and Cinderella to come over for tea and cake.

Just then, Little Red Riding Hood knocked on the door of the three little pigs' house.
After entering, Little Red Riding Hood said, "Cinderella just told me she feels unwell and can't come for tea.">

We finally get to eat cake!
More tea?
Yes, thank you.

"Then let's go see her!" the little pig said regretfully. He was not only handsome, but also had a kind heart. So, everyone packed up the tea and cake and set off to visit Cinderella.

[P16] The path to Cinderella's house is winding, and they have to pass through a big, dark forest. Guess who they will meet there?

The Three Little Pigs and Little Red Riding Hood are afraid of meeting the Big Bad Wolf, so they decide to run quietly and quickly to Cinderella's house. But the Big Bad Wolf still discovers their trail and guesses where they are going.

'I'll sneak ahead to Cinderella's house first,' the Big Bad Wolf thinks, 'As soon as they arrive, I'll eat them all up!'

[P17] The three little pigs and Little Red Riding Hood arrived at Cinderella's house and found someone lying in bed—this person was wearing Cinderella's favorite pink headscarf.
Little Red Riding Hood said, "Your eyes are so big!"
This person replied, "That's how I can see your cute face clearly!"
Little Red Riding Hood said again, "Your ears are so big!"
This person answered, "That's how I can hear your clear voice!"
The three little pigs examined this person carefully.
Little Pig said, "Your teeth are so big!"
"That's how I can better..."

[P18] "Eat you up!"
The Big Bad Wolf, roaring, jumped up from the bed and lunged at them.

However, Little Pig was calm,
because he knew exactly how to respond...

[P19] He dashed forward and, with all his might, stuffed a big piece of cake into the big, bloodthirsty mouth of the Big Bad Wolf.
"This is so delicious!" the Big Bad Wolf shouted, "Even better than little pigs and little girls!"

At that moment, the big pig rescued Cinderella from the closet.
Cinderella immediately fell in love with the hero who saved her.

Is this the most romantic part of the story? But I'm just a little pig!

It's okay,
no one is perfect.

But they didn't kiss, because this is a bedtime story for children.

[P20] From then on, the protagonists of these fairy tales lived happily ever after.
Everyone did a great job; this is the most suitable bedtime story I've ever read!

In this story,
we got everything we wanted!

Right! This story is fun, exciting, thrilling,
and romantic!

And we even got to eat
cake!

But I'm still hungry,
because I didn't eat anyone.

However, in my story,
you will never really eat anyone.

Wait a minute, this
child isn't asleep yet!

[P21] Are you still awake?! Oh, no! But this story is already finished! It seems we need a new story!
This time, can we tell a story with a happy ending?
Ha, a new story! I love bedtime stories!
Let's tell a story where we can eat bananas!
No, tell me a story where I can eat little animals!
I want to hear a story about a princess. Of course, I'm just saying that.
I hope the beginning of the story can go like this: 'Once upon a time...'
Which kind of story would you choose?
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《谁是主角？》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者和出版社信息，以及一只戴眼镜、穿绿色毛衣和红色短裤、手持蓝色书本的卡通小猪插图。
[P2] 页面文字描述了睡前读故事的美好时刻，并向三只小猪提问是否在听。画面中，三只小猪分别在踢足球、读书和跑步，似乎没有在听说话者。
[P3] 本页中，讲故事者提醒三只小猪故事即将开始，但三只小猪各自忙于踢球、读书和想吃蛋糕，尚未准备好进入故事角色，讲故事者催促他们快速进入角色，否则将换一个故事。
[P4] 本页讲述了三只小猪在妈妈的叮嘱下即将离开家去外面的世界闯荡，妈妈提醒他们要努力干活并小心大灰狼。画面中三只小猪正背对家园，走向标有“大千世界”的方向。
[P5] 三只小猪来到一片开满花的草地，大猪决定用稻草盖房子，但一个粉红色身影突然出现，三只小猪分别表达了对后续故事、午饭时间和对方身份的疑问。
[P6] 灰姑娘突然出现，提议讲一个关于公主的故事，并自夸其故事的浪漫与流行，但三只小猪对此表示不满，认为她打断了他们的故事，并质疑她的说法，其中一只小猪还抱怨自己还没开始盖砖房。
[P7] 本页讲述了灰姑娘故事的开端，同时三只小猪对故事内容表示质疑和不满，讲故事者则安排他们扮演故事中的反派角色。
[P8] 本页讲述了灰姑娘故事的开端，三只小猪被安排扮演继母和姐姐们，灰姑娘因无法参加舞会而哭泣，随后一个仙女出现。三只小猪对扮演角色表示困惑和不满，其中一只关心舞会时间，另一只只期待蛋糕，而讲故事者则在尝试引导故事继续。
[P9] 本页讲述了故事被重新安排，小红帽和大灰狼登场，讲故事者决定让灰姑娘扮演小红帽的妈妈，三只小猪扮演外婆，大灰狼则稍后出场，三只小猪对新安排表示困惑和不满。
[P10] 本页讲述了小红帽故事的开端，灰姑娘被安排扮演小红帽的妈妈，三只小猪被安排扮演外婆，他们对角色分配表示不满和困惑，而大灰狼则在森林中等待出场。
[P11] 本页描绘了小红帽在森林中遇到大灰狼的场景，同时三只小猪对被安排扮演外婆的角色表示不满和抱怨，其中一只小猪抱怨台词太少，另一只说饿了，还有一只想翻到下一页。
[P12] 在小红帽故事的森林场景中，三只小猪对角色分配不满，其中一只抱怨台词少，另一只想吃蛋糕，还有一只想离开；大灰狼则享受扮演坏人的乐趣；讲故事者试图阻止混乱，但故事即将失控。
[P13] 在森林场景中，三只小猪和小红帽等角色混乱地奔跑，纸片飞舞，大灰狼在旁嚎叫，画面中出现“把书撕坏！”的文字，表现出故事失控、角色混乱的场面。
[P14] 书被撕碎后，角色们讨论要讲一个什么样的新故事，大家提出了有趣、浪漫、惊险、兴奋和有蛋糕吃等不同要求，准备开始新的故事。
[P15] 三只小猪在家中喝茶吃蛋糕，小红帽来访告知灰姑娘身体不适无法赴约，于是大家决定带上茶点去看望灰姑娘。
[P16] 本页描绘了小红帽和三只小猪在前往灰姑娘家的路上穿过森林，他们害怕遇到大灰狼，决定悄悄跑过去，但大灰狼已发现他们的踪迹并计划抢先到达灰姑娘家吃掉他们。
[P17] 三只小猪和小红帽来到灰姑娘家，发现大灰狼假扮灰姑娘躺在床上，小红帽和小猪们依次对大灰狼的特征进行提问，大灰狼则用善意的谎言回应，但小小猪的话未说完，故事走向紧张。
[P18] 大灰狼假扮灰姑娘被识破后，从床上跳起扑向小红帽和三只小猪，场面紧张；而小小猪则保持镇定，似乎已有应对之策。
[P19] 大猪用蛋糕救下灰姑娘，灰姑娘爱上他；小猪和小红帽讨论故事的浪漫部分，灰姑娘安慰小猪；最后强调这是一个给孩子们读的睡前故事。
[P20] 本页描绘了童话角色们对新故事的满意评价，以及大灰狼因未吃到人而感到饥饿，但被小红帽和小猪们提醒故事中不能吃人，最后大猪发现孩子还没睡着，故事以温馨的睡前氛围收尾。
[P21] 故事角色们在听完一个故事后，纷纷表达对下一个故事的期待，提出了各种不同的故事类型，最后以提问读者选择哪种故事结尾。
[P22] 画面中，小红帽与大灰狼在雪地里对峙，大灰狼双手合十，面带狡黠微笑，小红帽则双手叉腰，神情警惕，背景是模糊的冬季森林。
